question: Which of the following is NOT one of the scenarios of National Digital Education Architecture (NDEAR) launched by the Government of India in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Develop Learn.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Digital Education Architecture (NDEAR)** is a program launched by the **Government of India in 2021** to provide a** digital infrastructure** for education in the country.
 
• **Manage Learn:** This scenario aims to provide a platform for **educators and learners** to manage their learning activities.
 
 
• It includes features such as** course management, assessment tools, and analytics.**
 
 
 
• **Learn: **This scenario focuses on providing **access to digital resources** for learners.
 
 
• It includes **e-books, videos, and interactive learning modules.**
 
 
 
• **Help Learn: **This scenario aims to provide support to learners through **online forums, chatbots, and other online resources.**
 
• Develop Learn is** not **one of the scenarios of NDEAR.
 
• The other options are all part of the program and aim to provide a** digital infrastructure **for education in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Together with the **Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, **it is managed by the** Ministry of Education**.
 
• According to this, the government will act as an **enabler, providing a framework **so that technology can be developed and built by anyone instead of developing technology solutions for the education sector.
 
• The institutional **design, timeline, governance model, and technology **of NDEAR will be advantageous to the teacher community as well as students.
 
• **NDEAR-compliant solutions **would follow the NDEAR frameworks and standards.
 
• Solutions that are NDEAR-compliant would be able to** communicate** with one another.
 
• The framework suggests that **solutions and systems** that were successful in one state could be applied to other parts of the nation.
